shell.title: MockPay Sandbox
shell.subtitle: MOCK PAYMENT PLATFORM
shell.footer: For local integration only. No real funds are processed, and no storefront business module is used.

auth.title: MockPay operator sign-in
auth.description: Use the configured MockPay operator credentials for this sandbox.
auth.invalidCredentials: The username or password is incorrect.

console.title: Mock payment platform
console.description: Create payment orders, use the standalone checkout, and inspect signed callbacks and retries.

create.title: Create payment
create.description: These fields mirror the create API. Replaying the same merchant order number and payload returns the original payment.

lookup.title: Look up a payment
lookup.description: Enter an existing payment number to inspect its status and callback history.
lookup.label: Payment number

guide.title: Sandbox workflow

create.title: Create a payment
create.description: Set the merchant order, amount, and callback URL to create an isolated payment.

pay.title: Pay in checkout
pay.description: Open checkout_url and choose Pay now. This console never bypasses the checkout.

notify.title: Watch callback delivery
notify.description: A signed notification is sent after payment. Failed deliveries back off and can be retried after exhaustion.

guide.isolation: MockPay uses its own tables and frontend folder. It does not call the storefront order, payment, or inventory modules.

form.merchantOrderNoHint: Replays with the same merchant order number must use an identical payload.
form.subject: Subject
form.amountHint: Use the smallest currency unit. For example, 3998 renders as 39.98.
form.notifyURLHint: The server sends a signed event with POST.

validation.merchantOrderNoLength: Merchant order number must be 64 characters or fewer
validation.amountInvalid: Amount must be a positive safe integer in cents
validation.subjectLength: Subject must be 200 characters or fewer
validation.notifyLength: Notification URL must be 2048 characters or fewer
validation.notifyInvalid: Notification URL must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL
validation.returnLength: Return URL must be 2048 characters or fewer
validation.returnInvalid: Return URL must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL
validation.expiresInvalid: Expiry must be an integer between 60 and 86400 seconds

detail.subtitle: Merchant order {{merchantOrderNo}}
detail.expiredNotice: This payment is past its expiry. The background worker will close it shortly.

fields.title: Payment details
fields.description: These values come directly from the mock payment API.

state.title: Payment state machine
state.note: pending can become paid or closed. Both paid and closed are terminal. The background worker closes expired payments automatically.

notifications.title: Callback delivery
notifications.description: Signed notifications use a backoff schedule. In-flight records refresh automatically.
notifications.emptyPending: A payment.paid notification appears here after the payment succeeds.

closeDialog.title: Close this payment?
closeDialog.description: Closing “{{subject}}” prevents payment and cannot be undone.

errors.network: Cannot reach the mock payment service. Check that the backend is running.
errors.invalidRequest: The request is invalid. Check the form values.
errors.duplicateOrder: This merchant order number already exists with a different payload.
errors.server: The mock payment service is unavailable.
errors.notClosable: The payment cannot be closed in its current state.
errors.notificationNotRetryable: Only exhausted notifications can be retried.
errors.loadNotifications: Refresh the callback history and try again.
